entry_long: Standard breakout entry (open + k x prior range); position size = target volatility / (prior range / prior close), so wide-range days buy less.
exit: Exit at same day close (default variant).
position_sizing: position = target volatility / (yesterday range / yesterday close)
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
